title: Nine Lives in Production
style: English, Eurobeat, playful high-energy night-drive mood, 155 BPM, driving four-on-the-floor kick, galloping synth bass, bright saw-lead arpeggios, distorted rhythm guitar, agile confident tenor vocal, stacked shout harmonies, dramatic risers, glossy wide 1990s dance mix
lyrics:
[Intro]
Green lights, blue screen
Ship it like a midnight dream

[Verse]
Paws on the keyboard, moon in the glass
Chasing down a bug and I'm moving fast
Coffee went cold but the build runs clean
Little black cat in a coding machine

[Pre-Chorus]
One more function, one more sign
Every warning turns to green in time

[Chorus]
Vibe code, ride the neon line
Nine lives running and the night is mine
Push to production, hear that engine purr
Fast little changes in a digital blur
Vibe code, no looking back
Tail in the air on a midnight track

[Verse]
Rubber-duck talking to the dashboard glow
I don't know the road, but the instincts know
Tests all passing as the sunrise starts
Shipping tiny miracles in modular parts

[Pre-Chorus]
One more function, one more sign
Every warning turns to green in time

[Chorus]
Vibe code, ride the neon line
Nine lives running and the night is mine
Push to production, hear that engine purr
Fast little changes in a digital blur
Vibe code, no looking back
Tail in the air on a midnight track

[Bridge]
If the server falls, I land on my feet
Patch the broken rhythm, bring it back on beat

[Chorus]
Vibe code, ride the neon line
Nine lives running and the night is mine
Push to production, hear that engine purr
Fast little changes in a digital blur
Vibe code, no looking back
Tail in the air on a midnight track

[Outro]
Green lights, blue screen
Ship it like a midnight dream
